questions.stem: A 5-year-old boy in India is brought to the hospital with a history of recurrent bacterial infections, including otitis media, sinusitis, and pneumonia. He has no significant family history of immunodeficiency disorders. Physical examination is unremarkable except for mild otitis media. Laboratory tests reveal markedly low levels of IgG, IgA, and IgM. Which condition is most likely to be diagnosed based on the clinical features and investigation findings in this child?
